name: FIFTY! YEP!
summary: Oralius asks you to bring him fifty Blackrock Medallions. He believes the orcs in the Burning Steppes are likely to have them.

sections.title: Oralius's Request
sections.body: Oralius seeks fifty Blackrock Medallions, and the orcs in the Burning Steppes are the likely source. You are asked to gather the medallions for him.

faq.q: Where can I find Blackrock Medallions?
faq.answer: Orcs in the Burning Steppes are likely to have Blackrock Medallions.

faq.q: Who is asking for the medallions?
faq.answer: Oralius is asking for fifty Blackrock Medallions.
